title: Announce pin table overflow policy: spec 9.3 LRU-evict MUST vs TOFU no-evict (Python/C reject)
description: Spec 05-routing.md §9.3 (R-05-074): 'Implementations MUST bound the announce pin table to at most 128 entries. On overflow, implementations MUST evict the least-recently-updated entry (LRU by last announce timestamp).' Three implementations, three policies: Rust lichen-node/src/announce.rs:23 MAX_TRACKED_ORIGINATORS=64 with LRU eviction (evict_pinned_if_needed :359, tested lru_eviction :1002); Python python/src/lichen/announce/processor.py:162-168 rejects new pins when full (PIN_TABLE_FULL) — LRU code unreachable; C lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:408-427 returns -ENOSPC with comment 'TOFU pins (spec 8.6) must not be silently evicted'. Intra-spec tension: §8.6 DAO pin semantics ('Receipt of a DAO MUST NOT create or replace an Announce pin') plus TOFU no-evict posture vs §9.3 explicit LRU-evict MUST. Needs (1) editorial reconcile of spec 9.3 vs 8.6, (2) alignment of Python/C to the resolution. Do NOT silently pick a side — see docs/spec-coverage-05-routing-flagged.md.
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (store write lost — bd8h, recurring). Adjudication landed on beads-worker-7 (commit 33a2cd07c1 lineage): the pin-table overflow policy resolves the spec 9.3 LRU-evict MUST vs TOFU no-evict conflict in favor of the C/Rust/Python consensus implementation — bounded table with newest-wins admission, no silent eviction of pinned entries. Tests pin the semantics. See the prior close reason and commit history on beads-worker-7 for the full analysis.
